sections.title: What Sonus is
sections.body: Sonus is a free place to learn about in-ear monitors (IEMs), discover new models and compare them side by side.

sections.title: Why it was created
sections.body: Getting into the IEM world can be confusing: driver types, impedance, tuning curves and more. Sonus was created to explain these things in plain language and to put real measurements next to every model.

sections.title: What you can do
sections.body: Browse the Showroom, read the Learn glossary, and compare IEMs with frequency response graphs normalized to 60 dB at 1 kHz so tuning is easy to see.

sections.title: Our goal
sections.body: To help beginners start with confidence, and to give experienced listeners a quick, clean way to browse and compare without visiting every official store.

sections.title: Credits
sections.body: Frequency response data is credited to the original measurers shown with each graph. Created by Hades.

terms.title: Terms
terms.imagesNote: Diagrams on the Learn pages are loaded from Wikimedia Commons and credited under each image.

sections.title: Informational use
sections.body: Sonus is provided for information and education only. Specs, prices and ratings are approximate and may differ from official sources. Ratings and insights reflect the creator's personal opinion.

sections.title: Images
sections.body: The product images on this site were edited by the creator to fit the website, but they come from the companies' own official images found online. All product names, brands, logos and images remain the property of their respective owners. No ownership or endorsement is claimed.

sections.title: Measurements
sections.body: Frequency response measurements are credited to their original measurers and are shown for comparison. Graphs from different rigs are not directly comparable.

sections.title: No affiliation
sections.body: Sonus is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any manufacturer or retailer, and does not sell products.

sections.title: Removal requests
sections.body: If you own any content shown here and want it credited or removed, please contact the creator and it will be handled promptly.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may be updated from time to time.

sections.title: Summary
sections.body: Sonus does not collect personal information. There are no accounts, forms or tracking of individual users.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: This website exists to share knowledge, especially for people who want to get into the IEM world, and for people who already know the basics and just want to browse IEMs without visiting official stores.

sections.title: On your device
sections.body: Your language, currency and theme choices, and your compare list, are saved only in your own browser (local storage and a small preference cookie) so the site remembers them. This information stays on your device and is not sent to us.

sections.title: Third parties
sections.body: Sonus does not sell or share data, and does not show ads.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this page can be sent to the creator.
